[PtrAnalysis](fix) Support runtime-aligned pointer bitcasts (#3432)

* [PtrAnalysis](fix) support runtime-aligned pointer bitcasts

Scale the complete per-lane displacement when widening pointer tensors. Keep proven strides and allow the runtime input to supply divisibility. Use the shared address calculation for byte-buffer views so offsets on both sides of a splat contribute to the quotient.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [Test] Bound bitcast absence checks to each kernel

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [PtrAnalysis] Keep this change scoped to code and tests

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [TritonToLinalg] Simplify pointer bitcast canonicalization

Leave addptr in its original element units. Move pointer bitcasts through splat and combine adjacent casts across pointee widths. Reuse the original SSA value when the round trip restores its type.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [TritonToLinalg] Keep the bitcast change to the width diagnostic

Skip cross-width pointer casts quietly and keep the existing equal-width canonicalization. Drop the round-trip optimization and its dedicated check from the runtime-offset change.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [PtrAnalysis] Bypass the dedicated byte-buffer bitcast rewrite

Let Unstructure and the later lowering consume cross-width pointers through the normal path. Check the source byte displacements and the pointers used by loads and stores in both modes, alongside the final word offsets.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

+@triton.jit
+def _load_widened_pointers(src, offsets_ptr, out, SCALAR_OFFSET: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    offsets = tl.load(offsets_ptr + lanes)
+    ptrs = (src + SCALAR_OFFSET + offsets).to(tl.pointer_type(tl.int32), bitcast=True)
+    tl.store(out + lanes, tl.load(ptrs))

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("src_dtype, scalar_offset", [(torch.int16, 0), (torch.uint8, 0), (torch.uint8, 1)])
+def test_pointer_bitcast_runtime_offsets(src_dtype, scalar_offset):
+    words = torch.arange(64, dtype=torch.int32) * 0x01010101 + 0x01020304
+    src = words.view(src_dtype)
+    indices = torch.arange(16, 48, dtype=torch.int32).flip(0)
+    # Both byte-buffer variants address the same words. With a scalar offset of
+    # one, only the sum of the scalar and per-lane offsets is divisible by four.
+    offsets = indices * (words.element_size() // src.element_size()) - scalar_offset
+    out = torch.empty_like(indices, device="npu")
+    _load_widened_pointers[(1, )](src.npu(), offsets.npu(), out, SCALAR_OFFSET=scalar_offset, BLOCK=indices.numel())
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.cpu(), words[indices.long()], rtol=0, atol=0)

+    x = tla.alloc((1024, ), DT, space="ub")

+            tla.simd.vscatter(a, dst[BASE], index, mask)
+            tla.simd.membar("VST_VLD")
+            r1 = tla.simd.vlds(dst[BASE])

+def predicate_kernel(X, Y, O, W: tl.constexpr, OP: tl.constexpr, PART: tl.constexpr):
+    OW: tl.constexpr = (W // 2 if OP == "ppack" else (W * 2 if OP == "punpack" else W))
+    ON: tl.constexpr = 2048 // OW
+    DT: tl.constexpr = tl.int8 if OW == 8 else (tl.int16 if OW == 16 else tl.int32)
+    x = tla.alloc((32, ), tl.uint8, space="ub")
+    y = tla.alloc((32, ), tl.uint8, space="ub")
+    out = tla.alloc((2, ON), DT, space="ub")
+    tla.load_gm_to_ub(tla.view(X, (32, )), x)
+    tla.load_gm_to_ub(tla.view(Y, (32, )), y)
+    with tla.scope.simd():
+        a = tla.simd.pld(x[0], width=W)
+        b = tla.simd.pld(y[0], width=W)
+        if OP == "ppack":
+            p = tla.simd.ppack(a, part=PART)
+            q = tla.simd.ppack(b, part=PART)
+        elif OP == "punpack":
+            p = tla.simd.punpack(a, part=PART)
+            q = tla.simd.punpack(b, part=PART)
+        elif OP == "pintlv":

+        tla.simd.vsts(out[1, 0], tla.simd.vsel(q, one, zero), dist="NORM_B8" if OW == 8 else

+"""Register permutation through native vselr, including optional result masks."""
+import os

+import torch

+@tla.jit
+def permutation_kernel(X, I, M, O, DT: tl.constexpr, W: tl.constexpr, MASKED: tl.constexpr, MODE: tl.constexpr):
+    N: tl.constexpr = 2048 // W
+    IT: tl.constexpr = tl.uint8 if W == 8 else (tl.uint16 if W == 16 else tl.uint32)
+    MT: tl.constexpr = tl.int8 if W == 8 else (tl.int16 if W == 16 else tl.int32)
+    x = tla.alloc((N, ), DT, space="ub")
+    i = tla.alloc((N, ), IT, space="ub")
+    m = tla.alloc((N, ), MT, space="ub")
+    out = tla.alloc((2, N), DT, space="ub")
+    tla.load_gm_to_ub(tla.view(X, (N, )), x)
+    tla.load_gm_to_ub(tla.view(I, (N, )), i)
+    tla.load_gm_to_ub(tla.view(M, (N, )), m)
+    with tla.scope.simd():
+        mask = tla.simd.vcmps(tla.simd.vlds(m[0]), 0, op=tla.simd.CMP.NE)
+        if not MASKED:
+            mask = None
+        a = tla.simd.vselr(tla.simd.vlds(x[0]), tla.simd.vlds(i[0]), mask, mode=MODE)
+        if MASKED:
+            b = tla.simd.vsel(mask, a, tla.simd.vdup(7, DT))
+        else:
+            b = a
+        tla.simd.vsts(out[0, 0], a, dist="NORM_B8" if W == 8 else ("NORM_B16" if W == 16 else "NORM_B32"))
+        tla.simd.vsts(out[1, 0], b, dist="NORM_B8" if W == 8 else ("NORM_B16" if W == 16 else "NORM_B32"))
+    tla.store_ub_to_gm(out, tla.view(O, (2, N)))
+
+
+TYPES = [("int8", "i8", 8), ("uint8", "u8", 8), ("int16", "i16", 16), ("uint16", "u16", 16), ("int32", "i32", 32),
+         ("uint32", "u32", 32), ("float16", "fp16", 16), ("bfloat16", "bf16", 16), ("float32", "fp32", 32),
+         ("float8e4nv", "fp8e4nv", 8)]
+
+
+def constants(typ, masked, mode):
+    name, _, w = typ
+    return dict(DT=getattr(tl, name), W=w, MASKED=masked, MODE=mode)
+
+
+def launch(typ, pattern, index_kind, mode="ZEROING"):
+    name, _, w = typ
+    n = 2048 // w
+    dtype = getattr(torch, {"float8e4nv": "float8_e4m3fn"}.get(name, name))
+    lane = torch.arange(n)
+    raw = (lane * 7 + 3) % 29 - (0 if name.startswith("uint") else 14)
+    data = raw.to(dtype)
+    bit_dtype = {8: torch.int8, 16: torch.int16, 32: torch.int32}[w]
+    if pattern == "bits":
+        # Preserve arbitrary payloads, NaNs, infinities and signed zero.
+        bits = (lane * 2654435761 + 12345).to(bit_dtype)
+        bits[:4] = torch.tensor([0, -(1 << (w - 1)), -1, (1 << (w - 1)) - 1], dtype=bit_dtype)
+        data = bits.view(dtype)
+    idx = lane.flip(0) if index_kind == "reverse" else (lane * 13 + 7) % (n // 2)
+    mask = {
+        "unmasked": lane >= 0, "all": lane >= 0, "none": lane < 0, "tail": lane < n - 5, "mixed": (lane * 7 + 3) % 11
+        < 5, "bits": (lane % 3) != 0
+    }[pattern]
+    out = torch.empty((2, n), dtype=dtype, device="npu")
+    compiled = permutation_kernel[(1, )](data.npu(), idx.to({8: torch.uint8, 16: torch.uint16, 32:
+                                                             torch.uint32}[w]).npu(),
+                                         mask.to({8: torch.int8, 16: torch.int16, 32: torch.int32}[w]).npu(), out,
+                                         **constants(typ, pattern != "unmasked", mode))
+    torch.npu.synchronize()
+    selected = data.view(bit_dtype).to(torch.int64)[idx]
+    old_bits = torch.tensor(7, dtype=dtype).view(bit_dtype).to(torch.int64)
+    ref = torch.stack((torch.where(mask, selected, 0), torch.where(mask, selected, old_bits)))
+    return out.cpu().view(bit_dtype).to(torch.int64), ref, compiled
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("typ", TYPES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("masked", (False, True))
+def test_ir(typ, masked):

+    module, ctx = compile_offline(permutation_kernel, dict(X=f"*{sig}", I=f"*u{w}", M=f"*i{w}", O=f"*{sig}"),

+    compile_native_kernel(permutation_kernel, dict(X=f"*{sig}", I=f"*u{w}", M=f"*i{w}", O=f"*{sig}"),
+                          constants(typ, True, "ZEROING"))
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("pattern", ("unmasked", "all", "none", "tail", "mixed", "bits"))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("index_kind", ("reverse", "repeated"))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ("ZEROING", "MERGING"))

+    actual, expected, _ = launch(typ, pattern, index_kind, mode)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)

+    input_offsets = n_offsets * (C_in * L_in) + ci_offsets * L_in + tl.arange(0, L_in)[None, None, :]
+    input_tile = tl.load(input_ptr + input_offsets)
+
+    co_offsets = tl.arange(0, C_out)[:, None, None]
+    weight_offsets = co_offsets * (C_in * K) + ci_offsets * K + tl.arange(0, K)[None, None, :]
+    weight_tile = tl.load(weight_ptr + weight_offsets)
+    bias_tile = tl.load(bias_ptr + tl.arange(0, C_out))
+
+    output = al.conv1d(input_tile, weight_tile, bias_tile, stride=1, padding=padding, dilation=1, groups=1)
+
+    output_co_offsets = tl.arange(0, C_out)[None, :, None]
+    output_offsets = (n_offsets * (C_out * L_out) + output_co_offsets * L_out + tl.arange(0, L_out)[None, None, :])
+    tl.store(output_ptr + output_offsets, output)
+
+
+def test_conv1d_asymmetric_padding():
+    N, C_in, L_in = 2, 16, 32
+    C_out, K = 32, 4
+    pad_left, pad_right = 1, 2
+    L_out = L_in + pad_left + pad_right - K + 1
+
+    x = torch.randn(N, C_in, L_in, dtype=torch.float16)
+    weight = torch.randn(C_out, C_in, K, dtype=torch.float16)
+    bias = torch.randn(C_out, dtype=torch.float16)
+    output = torch.empty(N, C_out, L_out, dtype=torch.float16).npu()
+
+    conv1d_kernel[(1, )](x.npu(), weight.npu(), bias.npu(), output, N=N, C_in=C_in, L_in=L_in, C_out=C_out, L_out=L_out,
+                         K=K, padding=(pad_left, pad_right))
+
+    padded_x = torch.nn.functional.pad(x, (pad_left, pad_right))
+    expected = torch.nn.functional.conv1d(padded_x, weight, bias)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output.cpu(), expected, rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-2)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_conv1d_asymmetric_padding()
